jobs.title: Mechanical Test & Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
McElroy is looking for a Test Engineer with knowledge and experience to develop test plans, procedures, and methods for complex machines. The successful test engineer will be collaborative in work style with the ability to work with a variety of departments. This position creates and executes test procedures to verify that the product’s mechanical, electrical power, hydraulic, and control systems meet specifications while analyzing and presenting test results and data to the design teams to ensure the verification and validation of all product requirements.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate test methods and equipment for the simulation of various mechanical and environmental conditions.
• Generate test plans, procedures, and work instructions from product specifications.
• Execute and conduct environmental and mechanical tests in accordance with test requirements and developed procedures.
• Setup, configure, and operate test setups, fixtures, and instrumentation as required by test plans, test standards, and other instructions.
• Implement and deploy test fixtures, testing apparatus and machines and verify their appropriateness.
• Ensure the accuracy and consistency of data through thorough documentation processes.
• Analyze and present test results and data to the design team and work with the team to resolve issues found during testing.
• Source, obtain quotations, and select required lab supplies and materials to build test fixtures to conduct tests.
• Design and assemble test fixtures per test plan, and applicable test standards.
• Validate test methods.
• Analyze and test new or revised designs to ensure the product is efficient and safe.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Agricultural Engineering required.
• Professional Engineer license preferred.
• 3-5 years of work experience in a related field.
• Knowledge of machines, mechanisms, materials, electrical power, general physics, control systems and hydraulics
• Knowledge of setting up and running data acquisition systems, similar to Labview and Somat/Catman
• Ability to comprehend, interpret, and implement industry standard test methodologies
• Ability to read blueprints, diagrams, drawings, and sketches is essential.
• Intermediate skill level in SolidWorks preferred.
• Collaborating with all stakeholders of a project: from assembly technicians to engineers to purchasing agents.

Must be able to routinely work between office and shop environment. Balance of work day may require bending, squatting, and climbing, while working on large scale products. Some domestic travel required. Mobility required between multi building complex covering several acres.

Safety-Sensitive Designation:

Jobs which involve one or more tasks or duties that could affect the safety and health of the employee performing the task or others are considered safety-sensitive. This position is safety-sensitive because, in addition to the essential functions, it also involves performing one or more of the following essential tasks or duties:

• The handling, packaging, processing, storage, disposal or transport of hazardous material
• The operation of a motor vehicle, other vehicle, equipment, machinery or power tools
• Repairing, maintaining or monitoring the performance or operation of any equipment, machinery or manufacturing process, the malfunction or disruption of which could result in injury or property damage
• The operation, maintenance or oversight of critical services and infrastructure including, but not limited to, electric, gas, and water utilities, power generation or distribution.
• The extraction, compression, processing, manufacturing, handling, packaging, storage, disposal, treatment or transport of potentially volatile, flammable, combustible materials, elements, chemicals or any other highly regulated component.

jobs.title: Controls Technician
jobs.description:
Job Title: Controls Technician

Job Description

This role supports operations and maintenance activities for landfill gas systems across multiple sites in the Oklahoma. This technician travels regularly in a company vehicle to various landfills to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain landfill gas collection and control equipment. The position focuses on safe, reliable field work, hands-on mechanical repairs, and accurate data collection to support environmental engineering projects.

Responsibilities

• Travel regularly (home each night however) within Oklahoma (all within 100 miles of Tulsa) to multiple landfill sites using a company vehicle to perform field service work.
• Troubleshoot landfill gas control systems and identify issues affecting system performance and safety.
• Perform repairs on control systems, including flare and related control components.
• Pull, repair, and reinstall pumps used in landfill gas collection systems.
• Service and repair air compressors used in landfill gas operations.
• Perform pipe fusion repairs (HDPE) on landfill gas piping and related infrastructure.
• Complete accurate data entry and documentation of field activities, repairs, and test results.
• Work outdoors in varying weather conditions, walking extensively across landfill and field environments.
• Follow all safety procedures and contribute to a safety-focused culture in all field and travel activities.
• Maintain a clean driving record and operate company vehicles in a safe and responsible manner.
• Coordinate with operations and maintenance teams to prioritize work, communicate site conditions, and support project goals.

Essential Skills

• Experience working in an outdoor environment that requires extensive walking, such as military, landfill, or field service work.
• Mechanical and electrical experience with hands-on repair and maintenance of equipment.
• Ability to troubleshoot control systems and mechanical components in the field.
• Ability to perform accurate data collection and data entry for field activities.
• Clean driving record, with the ability to pass a three-year Motor Vehicle Report review.
• Comfort working in landfill and field environments while adhering to safety protocols.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

• Experience in landfill operations or environmental engineering projects is a plus.
• OSHA 40 Hazwoper training or experience working on hazardous waste or environmental projects is beneficial.
• Experience with environmental data collection systems and basic reporting is helpful.

Work Environment

This position is field-based and involves frequent travel within Oklahoma (Tulsa, Muskogee, Oklahoma City) to various landfill sites to perform repair and troubleshooting work. Will be home almost every night! The technician works primarily outdoors in landfill and field environments that require extensive walking and exposure to changing weather conditions. A company truck is provided for travel, and per diem is available for overnight stays, which are described as rare. The role involves working with landfill gas systems, control panels, pumps, air compressors, and piping, using mechanical tools and field testing equipment. The organization promotes a strong safety culture and a people-first environment, with an employee-owned structure and an ESOP program that allows employees to share in the company’s financial growth

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract to Hire position based out of Tulsa, OK.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $21.00 - $23.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.
